data.Q: Why do Azariah and the priests hurry Uzziah out?
data.A: Because they see leprosy on Uzziah’s forehead.
data.wrong_answer: Because Uzziah is raging at them.

data.Q: Who do the priests hurry out after they see the leprosy?
What happens while Uzziah rages at the priests?
data.A: Leprosy breaks out on Uzziah’s forehead.

data.Q: Why is Uzziah eager to leave?
data.A: Because the Lord has afflicted him.
data.wrong_answer: Because the priests hurry him out.
